RY-L01-S01-A01.title: Healing
RY-L01-S01-A01.description: A combined practice addressing the physical, psycho-emotional and energetic levels in the source system.
RY-L01-S01-A01.effect: Described as supporting holistic recovery and attunement to the Reiki Yggdrasil flow.

RY-L01-S01-A02.title: Intuition
RY-L01-S01-A02.description: Developing the ability to understand a situation without prolonged logical analysis.
RY-L01-S01-A02.effect: Intended to support faster decisions and selection of an appropriate course of action.

RY-L01-S01-A03.title: Protection
RY-L01-S01-A03.description: Gentle structuring of the energetic field and reflection of unwanted influence.
RY-L01-S01-A03.effect: Used in the source for crowded places, difficult communication and situations of external pressure.

RY-L01-S01-A04.title: Working with a Situation
RY-L01-S01-A04.description: Attunement toward a harmonious development of an event, task or life situation.
RY-L01-S01-A04.effect: Intended to help choose the best available development path and connect the practice with a concrete goal.

RY-L01-S02-A01.title: Charging an Object
RY-L01-S02-A01.description: Giving an object the quality of the general flow or of a specific attunement.
RY-L01-S02-A01.effect: Used to create a symbolic carrier object that supports a chosen attunement.

RY-L01-S02-A02.title: Money-Flow Activation
RY-L01-S02-A02.description: Working with inner limitations and a person's relationship to material and money flow.
RY-L01-S02-A02.effect: Intended to support a more balanced relationship with money and material resources.

RY-L01-S02-A03.title: Cleansing a Person
RY-L01-S02-A03.description: Cleansing the person's energetic structure from unwanted layers in the source model.
RY-L01-S02-A03.effect: Used to restore a sense of clarity, strength and a more even state.

RY-L01-S02-A04.title: Cleansing Space and Objects
RY-L01-S02-A04.description: Working with unwanted information or atmosphere in a home, objects and the surrounding environment.
RY-L01-S02-A04.effect: Intended to make the space feel lighter, calmer and more suitable for practice.

RY-L01-S02-A05.title: Breaking a Connection
RY-L01-S02-A05.description: Cleansing or releasing disharmonious emotional and energetic bonds.
RY-L01-S02-A05.effect: Intended to free energy tied up in painful contacts or memories.

RY-L01-S03-A01.title: Predestination
RY-L01-S03-A01.description: Attunement to understanding one's direction and life vector.
RY-L01-S03-A01.effect: Intended to help distinguish what fits a person's path from what leads away from it.

RY-L01-S03-A02.title: Emotion
RY-L01-S03-A02.description: Stabilising the psycho-emotional state and releasing excessive emotional load.
RY-L01-S03-A02.effect: Intended to even out reactions, reduce inner conflict and support overall well-being.

RY-L01-S03-A03.title: Activation
RY-L01-S03-A03.description: Bringing additional energy to action when there is tiredness or stagnation.
RY-L01-S03-A03.effect: Intended to help move from apathy into motion without harsh self-pressure.

RY-L01-S03-A04.title: Power
RY-L01-S03-A04.description: Activating inner strength, confidence and the capacity to influence a situation.
RY-L01-S03-A04.effect: Intended to support a stable position and calmer, more confident self-expression.

RY-L01-S03-A05.title: Sexuality
RY-L01-S03-A05.description: Harmonising the sexual sphere and the energy of attraction.
RY-L01-S03-A05.effect: Intended to support bodily vitality, attractiveness and self-acceptance.

RY-L01-S03-A06.title: Flight
RY-L01-S03-A06.description: A contemplative practice of moving awareness through time and space for observation and exploration.
RY-L01-S03-A06.effect: Used to explore causes, consequences and possible developments of events.

RY-L01-S03-A07.title: Intellect
RY-L01-S03-A07.description: Developing perception, analysis, systematisation and assimilation of information.
RY-L01-S03-A07.effect: Intended to support learning, new knowledge and cognitive resources.

RY-L01-S03-A08.title: Karma
RY-L01-S03-A08.description: Working symbolically with negative experience and patterns associated with past-life narratives.
RY-L01-S03-A08.effect: Intended to help recognise and release outdated behavioural and emotional patterns.

RY-L01-S04-A01.title: Clairvoyance
RY-L01-S04-A01.description: Activation of subtle perception and the symbolic 'third eye' language of the system.
RY-L01-S04-A01.effect: Used to explore hidden causes, images, field states and deeper connections.

RY-L01-S04-A02.title: Past Lives
RY-L01-S04-A02.description: Connecting with past-life imagery and related egregorial narratives in the source tradition.
RY-L01-S04-A02.effect: Used as a symbolic way to access resource, knowledge and skills from deep memory.

RY-L01-S04-A03.title: Creating a Situation
RY-L01-S04-A03.description: Forming a desired situation through a clear goal and sustained concentration.
RY-L01-S04-A03.effect: Intended not only to select a path of development but to focus attention on creating one.

RY-L01-S04-A04.title: Knowledge
RY-L01-S04-A04.description: Attunement to an informational flow and to receiving needed answers.
RY-L01-S04-A04.effect: Intended to support quicker access to knowledge, ideas and solutions in a familiar field.

RY-L01-S05-A01.title: Connection with the World
RY-L01-S05-A01.description: Expansion of awareness and symbolic connection with the 'Genius of Earth' level.
RY-L01-S05-A01.effect: Described as strengthening other attunements and broadening awareness of the consequences of actions.

RY-L01-S05-A02.title: Connection with the Gods
RY-L01-S05-A02.description: Attunement to qualities and forces represented by figures of the Scandinavian pantheon.
RY-L01-S05-A02.effect: Used symbolically to cultivate qualities such as protection, wisdom, strength, inspiration, fertility or clarity.
